messages:
alex: Noticed an oddity on the latency dashboard for /v1/prompt-stream — p50 unchanged, p95 up ~90ms starting at 09:03, p99 barely budged. Could be routing or telemetry. Anyone have quick thoughts?

nina: Same. Was looking at rollout traffic around that time. We increased fallback weight for quota-exceeded clients.

priya: If fallback path has a different warm cache behavior it'll inflate mid-tail but not necessarily p99. Also check if we changed percentile aggregator paths last week.

alex: My console query: `env:prod service:api endpoint:/v1/prompt-stream | percentile(latency_ms, 50,95,99) by endpoint, route`

metrics-bot: Alert: p95 latency for /v1/prompt-stream crossed 180ms at 2026-05-12 09:04:12 — rolling sample 5m count 420.

lorenzo: Quick reproduction: run the same percentile split by `route, model_variant` and include `count()` so we can see cohort sizes. Small cohorts can swing p95.

alex: Ran that: main route p95=140ms count=390, quota-fallback route p95=360ms count=30, combined p95=155ms. p99 for main is 520ms but fallback p99 is 380ms.

nina: So combined p95 is being pulled by the 30-sample fallback but p99 remains dominated by main's long tail. Classic micro-cohort effect.

priya: Two follow-ups: 1) We should show per-route/variant pcts in the rollout panel. 2) Display per-percentile sample counts and a small CI or "unstable" flag when count < 100.

alex: Agreed. Also we should avoid misleading alerts that only look at combined p95. Maybe add a rule: if >10% delta when excluding routes <5% traffic, suppress or attach context.

lorenzo: Note: backend telemetry uses tdigest rollups for realtime pctiles and exact aggregation for historical queries. That mismatch can make comparisons confusing if one view uses realtime rollups and another uses exact. We should document that prominently.

metrics-bot: Reminder: telemetry-team README updated with rollup vs exact behavior link: https://go/docs/telemetry-rollups (please check).

priya: UX suggestion: in the alert template, include a pre-computed `influence` number = delta(combined_p95, p95_excluding_small_routes) and a table showing top 3 contributing routes with counts.

nina: Ops note: for quota fallbacks we also want a small metric showing "fallback_fraction" per endpoint on the dashboard so oncall sees routing changes without query gymnastics.

alex: Action items: Nina will add fallback_fraction to the rollout dashboard (small tile), Lorenzo will add per-route pctiles to the rollout breakdown, Priya will update alert template with sample counts + influence metric.

lorenzo: I'll open UI PR and link to telemetry docs. ETA tomorrow.

priya: I'll draft the alert patch and add an explanation snippet for interpreting p50/p95/p99 when cohorts are unbalanced.

alex: Thanks team. Once PRs land, let's run a smoke check during the next small rollout to see if alerts are more actionable. :rocket:

metrics-bot: NOTE: when filing follow-ups, tag `telemetry` and `eng-platform` so docs and UI stay in sync.
